purpose_context: The foundation pack's default routing catalog records prices and availability that go stale as providers change them. A weekly scheduled run compares the catalog with approved public sources and, on a difference, proposes one pull request that a person reviews; it never merges itself (#315, charter ADR-0080 decision 14).
purpose_tldr: Keep the default routing catalog's prices and model availability current through a weekly, human-reviewed pull request.
